name: Investigation notes for SameDiffScopeSerdeTest closed array bug

investigation.symptom: 3 tests fail with 'This array is closed. Unable to determine equality.' in SameDiffScopeSerdeTest
investigation.pattern: All 3 tests: call eval() to get output, do a conversion (constant/variable), call eval() again, assertEquals fails because first output array was closed
investigation.root_cause_hypothesis: DSP plan executor closes/deallocates output arrays from previous executions when plan re-executes. The SDVariable.eval() result is backed by the plan's output buffer which gets reused or freed on next execution.
investigation.fix_direction: eval() should return a detached copy of the output, or DSP should not close outputs that have external references. Need to check if eval() already calls .dup() or if it returns the plan output directly.
